title: Court Filing Review
description: Court Filing contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-legal-court-filing-review
  title: Court Filing Review
  description: Court Filing contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
  version: legal_court_filing_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: legal/court_filing
    sourcePath: Schemas/legal/court_filing
    sourceVersion: legal_court_filing_v1
    sourceDigest: 6f71369ef3ab23d1d2b821bbce45f2857c2fc0fae27c4e86d9a1984a9f3ecb56
    derivedFrom: docubricks-legal-court-filing
spec:
  role: review
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Court Filing
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: filing-date
              name: filing_date
              label: Filing Date
              description: Date the document was filed with the court, format YYYY-MM-DD
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: hearing-date
              name: hearing_date
              label: Hearing Date
              description: Date of any associated hearing, trial, or oral argument, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not scheduled
                or not stated)
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: filing-type
              name: filing_type
              label: Filing Type
              description: "The type of court document. One of: Complaint | Answer | Motion | Brief | Opposition | Reply |
                Order | Judgment | Stipulation | Subpoena | Notice | Declaration | Deposition | Petition |
                Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: court-level
              name: court_level
              label: Court Level
              description: "The level of the court. One of: Federal | State | Appellate | Administrative | Tribal | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: district-or-division
              name: district_or_division
              label: District Or Division
              description: The specific district, division, or department of the court (e.g., "Southern District of New
                York", "Civil Division, Dept. 45")
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: case-number
              name: case_number
              label: Case Number
              description: The official docket or case number assigned by the court (e.g., "1:25-cv-04812-LTS", "Case No.
                BC712345")
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: bar-number
              name: bar_number
              label: Bar Number
              description: State bar number of the filing attorney
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: law-firm
              name: law_firm
              label: Law Firm
              description: Name of the law firm representing the filing party (null if in-house or pro se)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: attorney-email
              name: attorney_email
              label: Attorney Email
              description: Email address of the filing attorney (null if not provided)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: relief-requested
              name: relief_requested
              label: Relief Requested
              description: Summary of the relief sought in this filing (up to 300 chars)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: causes-of-action
              name: causes_of_action
              label: Causes Of Action
              description: Array of strings naming each cause of action or claim (e.g., ["Breach of Contract", "Fraudulent
                Misrepresentation", "Unjust Enrichment"])
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: jurisdictional-basis
              name: jurisdictional_basis
              label: Jurisdictional Basis
              description: "The basis for the court's jurisdiction. One of: Federal_Question | Diversity | Supplemental |
                State | Bankruptcy | Admiralty | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: jury-demand
              name: jury_demand
              label: Jury Demand
              description: Boolean — true if the filing includes a demand for trial by jury
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
            - id: pages
              name: pages
              label: Pages
              description: Total number of pages in the filed document as integer (null if not stated)
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: court-name
              name: court_name
              label: Court Name
              description: Full official name of the court (e.g., "United States District Court for the Southern District of
                New York", "Superior Court of the State of California, County of Los Angeles")
              dataType: string
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: judge-name
              name: judge_name
              label: Judge Name
              description: Name of the presiding judge or magistrate (null if not yet assigned or not stated)
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: case-name
              name: case_name
              label: Case Name
              description: The case caption name (e.g., "Apex Corp. v. Meridian Technologies, Inc.")
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: plaintiff-name
              name: plaintiff_name
              label: Plaintiff Name
              description: Full name of the plaintiff(s); if multiple, concatenate with "; " separator
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: defendant-name
              name: defendant_name
              label: Defendant Name
              description: Full name of the defendant(s); if multiple, concatenate with "; " separator
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: filing-party
              name: filing_party
              label: Filing Party
              description: "Which party filed this document. One of: Plaintiff | Defendant | Third_Party | Court | Other"
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: attorney-name
              name: attorney_name
              label: Attorney Name
              description: Full name of the attorney signing or filing the document
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: document-id-present
      severity: error
      description: Every extracted record must carry a document_id — system invariant required for lineage tracking,
        audit trail, and deduplication
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: document_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: document_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: document_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(document_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-acceptable
      severity: warning
      description: Overall extraction confidence below 0.68 indicates the filing may be a low-quality scan,
        handwritten, or in an unsupported format; route to quarantine for human review
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.68
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.68
      supported: true
    - id: filing-type-valid-enum
      severity: warning
      description: Filing type must be a recognized enumeration; invalid values break routing to litigation
        management and e-discovery workflows
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Complaint
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Answer
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Motion
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Brief
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Opposition
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Reply
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Order
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Judgment
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Stipulation
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Subpoena
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Notice
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Declaration
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Deposition
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Petition
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: filing_type
            right:
              value: Other
      sourceExpression: filing_type IN ('Complaint', 'Answer', 'Motion', 'Brief', 'Opposition', 'Reply', 'Order',
        'Judgment', 'Stipulation', 'Subpoena', 'Notice', 'Declaration', 'Deposition', 'Petition', 'Other')
      supported: true
    - id: case-number-not-null
      severity: warning
      description: Case number is the primary docket identifier; records without a case number cannot be linked to a
        matter or tracked in litigation management systems
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: case_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: case_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: case_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(case_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: court-name-present
      severity: warning
      description: Court name is required to determine jurisdiction, applicable rules, and routing to the correct
        legal team; absence triggers review
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: court_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: court_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: court_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(court_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: filing-date-present
      severity: warning
      description: Filing date is required to calculate deadlines, statutes of limitations, and response windows;
        absence prevents deadline management
      rule:
        op: present
        field: filing_date
      sourceExpression: filing_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: hearing-date-after-filing
      severity: warning
      description: Hearing date cannot precede filing date; inversion indicates a date extraction error and flags
        the record for human review
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: hearing_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: filing_date
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: hearing_date
            right:
              field: filing_date
      sourceExpression: hearing_date IS NULL OR filing_date IS NULL OR hearing_date >= filing_date
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      case_number:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Case number is the primary docket identifier for linking filings across a matter; must be extracted
          exactly as formatted to ensure accurate docket tracking and e-filing compliance
      filing_date:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Filing date is the legal anchor for calculating deadlines, statutes of limitations, and response
          windows; even a one-day error can constitute a missed deadline with procedural consequences
      court_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Court name determines jurisdiction, applicable procedural rules, and routing to the responsible
          legal team; errors cause misrouting of matter management tasks
      bar_number:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Attorney bar number is required for e-filing system validation and professional responsibility
          tracking; inaccurate values prevent filing acceptance
      filing_type:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Filing type determines routing to litigation workflows (discovery, motions calendar, hearing
          scheduling) and sets response deadline calculation logic
      case_name:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Case name is used for display and search in matter management systems; must match the official case
          caption
      plaintiff_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Plaintiff identity is required for matter management, conflict-of-interest checks, and case
          strategy routing
      defendant_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Defendant identity is required for conflict-of-interest checks, OFAC screening, and litigation risk
          assessment
      hearing_date:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Hearing date drives calendar management and deadline reminders for litigation teams; errors can
          cause missed court appearances
      attorney_name:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Attorney name is required for matter management and professional responsibility tracking
      jury_demand:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Jury demand status affects trial scheduling and litigation strategy; false negatives may waive jury
          rights under applicable rules
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-haiku
    maxTokens: 8192
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Court filings and legal pleadings require precise extraction of structured case identifiers (case
      numbers, court names, judge assignments) as well as nuanced classification of filing types, causes of
      action, and jurisdictional bases. Legal pleadings contain specialized terminology and cross-referential
      language that benefits from Claude Sonnet's strong legal domain understanding. The higher token budget
      (8192) accommodates lengthy briefs, complaints with multiple counts, and motions with attached exhibits
      or declarations. Temperature 0.0 ensures deterministic extraction of case numbers, bar numbers, and
      filing dates — all of which must match exactly for e-filing system validation and docket management.
      Claude Haiku serves as fallback for simple, short-form court documents such as notices, stipulations,
      and one-page orders.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      filing_type:
        type: string
        description: "The type of court document. One of: Complaint | Answer | Motion | Brief | Opposition | Reply |
          Order | Judgment | Stipulation | Subpoena | Notice | Declaration | Deposition | Petition | Other"
      court_level:
        type: string
        description: "The level of the court. One of: Federal | State | Appellate | Administrative | Tribal | Other"
      court_name:
        type: string
        description: Full official name of the court (e.g., "United States District Court for the Southern District of
          New York", "Superior Court of the State of California, County of Los Angeles")
      district_or_division:
        type: string
        description: The specific district, division, or department of the court (e.g., "Southern District of New
          York", "Civil Division, Dept. 45")
      judge_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the presiding judge or magistrate (null if not yet assigned or not stated)
      case_number:
        type: string
        description: The official docket or case number assigned by the court (e.g., "1:25-cv-04812-LTS", "Case No.
          BC712345")
      case_name:
        type: string
        description: The case caption name (e.g., "Apex Corp. v. Meridian Technologies, Inc.")
      filing_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the document was filed with the court, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      hearing_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of any associated hearing, trial, or oral argument, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not scheduled
          or not stated)
        format: date
      plaintiff_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the plaintiff(s); if multiple, concatenate with "; " separator
      defendant_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the defendant(s); if multiple, concatenate with "; " separator
      filing_party:
        type: string
        description: "Which party filed this document. One of: Plaintiff | Defendant | Third_Party | Court | Other"
      attorney_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the attorney signing or filing the document
      bar_number:
        type: string
        description: State bar number of the filing attorney
      law_firm:
        type: string
        description: Name of the law firm representing the filing party (null if in-house or pro se)
      attorney_email:
        type: string
        description: Email address of the filing attorney (null if not provided)
      relief_requested:
        type: string
        description: Summary of the relief sought in this filing (up to 300 chars)
      causes_of_action:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of strings naming each cause of action or claim (e.g., ["Breach of Contract", "Fraudulent
          Misrepresentation", "Unjust Enrichment"])
      jurisdictional_basis:
        type: string
        description: "The basis for the court's jurisdiction. One of: Federal_Question | Diversity | Supplemental |
          State | Bankruptcy | Admiralty | Other"
      jury_demand:
        type: boolean
        description: Boolean — true if the filing includes a demand for trial by jury
      pages:
        type: integer
        description: Total number of pages in the filed document as integer (null if not stated)
    required:
      - case_number
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - case_number
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - parties
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
